name: cobl
description: Cobl is the intelligence layer for sales people. It connects to your CRM, emails, meetings, tools and documents, brings together every signal around your accounts and deals, and tells you the right action at the right time.

interface.longDescription:
Cobl is the intelligence layer for sales people. It connects to your CRM, emails, meetings, tools and documents, brings together every signal around your accounts and deals, and tells you the right action at the right time.

With Cobl in ChatGPT, your AI works with the full context around a customer:

- Spot opportunities early: Know which accounts to work and why now. Cobl reads the signals and gets you the meeting with the right person.
- Master every deal: Know what is proven, what is missing and who really decides, after every meeting and email.
- Prove your value: Give each stakeholder a reason to say yes. Cobl builds the argument, the proof and the documents your champion can share.
- Get it signed: Cobl watches each deal, builds your strategy to win and keeps the path to signature visible for both sides. You know when to act and what to do.

You stay in control. You review every output and you decide what goes to the buyer.

Requires a Cobl account. Your work stays in Cobl, so you can continue it in the Cobl app.
defaultPrompt: What should I work on next based on my pipeline
Send me a recap of the last call with the client

positive.description: Get the status of a deal
positive.prompt: Open my Acme project and tell me where this deal stands
positive.expected_behavior: A summary of the Acme Corp project built from its files: client, budget (60,000 to 80,000 EUR), deadline, decision makers, RFP requirements and the next step (proposal due 20 October 2026).

positive.description: Write a business proposal from deal room files
positive.prompt: Write a proposal for Acme using the files in my Acme project
positive.expected_behavior: The run starts within a few seconds and ChatGPT reports its progress. Within 1 to 10 minutes the status is "completed" and a new proposal document appears under documents/ in the Acme project, covering the client's needs, solution, plan and price.

positive.prompt: Draft our response to the RFP in my Acme project
positive.expected_behavior: The run starts within a few seconds. Within 1 to 10 minutes the status is "completed" and an RFP response document appears under documents/ in the Acme project, answering each of the 5 requirements in acme-rfp.pdf.

positive.prompt: Create a new Cobl project called Globex supply chain deal
positive.expected_behavior: A new project named "Globex supply chain deal" is created and ChatGPT confirms it. It appears in the project list at app.cobl.ai.
The proposal from test case 2 renders inline in ChatGPT as a document card.

negative.prompt: Send the Acme proposal to jane@acme.com by email
What's the weather in Paris today?

review.commerce_description: Cobl does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.
